name: Korean FMC Championship 2025

information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 3x3x3 최소회전 종목만 진행되는 대회입니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanFMCChampionship2025#65260-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanFMCChampionship2025#65259-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # This competition ONLY holds the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves event. If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanFMCChampionship2025#65260-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KoreanFMCChampionship2025#65259-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
